purpose: Teach: 賑わい/背骨/減価/声高/子女/食い違い/異に/突っ込ま

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、江戸時代の、本気で、絶対、賑わい、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on the bustle and energy of the Edo period was genuinely impressive. I was really moved by your work.
lines.style: Warm, steady voice with clear admiration. Measured pace. Leans forward slightly. The tone of a teacher who genuinely sees the student's effort and wants them to know it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代人の、本気で、絶対、背骨、絶対、研究、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I put a lot of care into researching how people lived back then—their struggles and their lives. I'm grateful for your feedback.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Quiet earnestness, not performative. Eyes briefly meet the teacher's. Slight softness on 'grateful'—she means it, not just saying it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 資産の、本気で、絶対、減価、絶対、償却、絶対、歴史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you handled the economic history—the depreciation of assets over time—showed real breadth of thinking. That's the kind of wide perspective historians need.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Slight pause before key words to let them land. Calm professional tone, genuinely engaged with the substance. A nod of recognition.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦前の、本気で、絶対、声高、絶対、な議論、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I tried to show how the debates before the war were so heated, and how people really had to take positions. That required going deep into the sources.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underlying the politeness. Direct eye contact. The earnestness of someone defending their own thinking. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 貴族の、本気で、絶対、子女、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The section on how noble families educated their daughters during that period—you handled it with such care. It showed real historical thinking.
lines.style: Appreciative and warm. A slight smile in the voice. Takes a beat, as if picturing the paper. The tone of someone seeing a student step into competence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。記録の、本気で、絶対、食い違い、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. There were so many contradictions in the historical records—I had to sit with them, compare different accounts, and build my argument carefully from there.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly introspective. The tone of someone who did hard work and is describing it without needing to oversell. Matter-of-fact but with quiet pride beneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 学派が、本気で、絶対、見解を、絶対、異に、絶対、する、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you traced how different schools of thought came to different conclusions about the same evidence—that's sophisticated historical reasoning. I really admired that section.
lines.style: Deliberate, reflective pacing. The words come with weight. A genuine nod in the voice. This is a teacher recognizing a moment where understanding deepened.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。市場が、本気で、絶対、突っ込ま、絶対、れた、絶対、状況、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes, that part took the longest—showing how the market pressures and social forces created the situation that scholars were trying to explain. It all connects.
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate tone. The culmination of the conversation. Genuine satisfaction in having figured something out. A slight trailing-off, like she's still turning it over in her mind.
